props.kicker: A tabletop dice tracker with a devilish sense of humour
props.title: Devil Dice Tracker — your rolls, recorded. Your luck, ==judged==.
props.subtitle: Every roll logged. Every streak remembered. Every excuse on the record.

slides.notes: Set the tone: this is a game-night tool that talks back. One line on the premise, then move.

left.label: Table legend
left.title: What every group swears
points: The dice are cursed — or blessed, or out to get Dave personally
Streaks and slumps become folklore after every session
Nobody logs a session's rolls, so nobody can prove a thing

right.label: The reality
right.title: What anyone actually measured
points: Not a single roll on record
Not one verified hot streak in the group's history
The d20's alleged vendetta remains entirely anecdotal

slides.notes: Every table has these arguments. The gap isn't opinion — it's that nobody keeps data.

props.title: A fast roll logger that keeps the ==session's story==.

items.title: Tap to log
items.body: Tap in each roll mid-game — fast enough that logging never interrupts the night.

items.title: The session's story
items.body: Totals, averages, crits and fumbles, kept roll by roll until the table's settled it.

items.title: Who's really hot
items.body: Per-player stats settle the oldest argument in gaming: who's actually rolling well.

slides.notes: Three pillars: capture fast, keep the whole story, and name who's hot with data.

items.title: Pick the die
items.body: d4 through d20, one tap. No forms, no setup, no leaving the table.

items.title: Log the roll
items.body: Tap the number you rolled. Two seconds, and you're back in the game.

items.title: Done — stats write themselves
items.body: Totals, averages and streaks build as you play. The teasing writes itself afterwards.

slides.notes: The whole pitch is speed: if logging takes effort mid-game, nobody does it. This takes seconds.

messages.text: The d20 hates me. It's personal at this point.
Receipts: 14 rolls this session, 3 natural 20s, average 13.1. The d20 is fine.
Okay, but what about the fumbles?
2 fumbles, 1 crit. I run a playful infernal ledger — and the devil never forgets a claim.

slides.notes: The theme is the feature: a running verdict on your luck, delivered with a devil's sense of humour.

tiles.title: Every die
tiles.body: Log any polyhedral roll with one tap.

tiles.title: Hot-streak watch
tiles.body: Per-player stats expose who's really rolling well.

tiles.title: Highlight reel
tiles.body: Natural 20s and nat 1s get their moment.

tiles.title: The devil's judgement
tiles.body: A running, teasing read on your luck.

tiles.title: Session ledger
tiles.body: Every session's full story, kept on record.

slides.notes: Run through the tiles quickly. Land on the devil's judgement — that's the memorable one.
